layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Dark-red rectangular frame wraps the whole canvas with pale-pink fill inside. One white scatter plot centered, gray gridlines, darker gray zero line at y=0, three interleaved dotted spirals (blue, black, red). Yellow badge '46' top-right. No title/bullets/footer.

regions.name: plot
regions.content: White chart area with grid and three dotted spirals

visual_elements.description: Plot axes, white bg, grid #DCDCDC, zero line y=0 #7F7F7F, axis ink #404040; x ticks 0..35 step 5, y ticks -10..40 step 10
Dotted spiral blue #0000FF, bbox [0.272,0.319,0.648,0.619]; outer start ~(4,9.5), peak y~28 near x~16-18, right ~(27,18), inner end ~(20,14)
Dotted spiral black #000000, bbox [0.308,0.363,0.731,0.670]; outer end ~(32,8), bottom y~3-8, left ~(8,15), top ~(15,24), inner end ~(22,15)
Dotted spiral red #FF0000, bbox [0.369,0.270,0.710,0.606]; start ~(19,31.5), right ~(30,20), down ~(27,10)/(20,7), inner arm ~(18,20) extending left to ~(12,15)
Tiny gray illegible mark near plot center [0.531,0.376,0.552,0.396], #9A9A9A [?]

typography_notes: Plain sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Axis numerals ~9 pt regular dark gray, centered on ticks; '-10' carries minus sign. Badge '46' ~13 pt regular dark, centered. No bold/italic/title.
